title: 第17章 我从死人堆里捡了个活人第18章 左手碎骨手右手太平剑
content_zh:
大街上，端木斋忙活到现在才从刘家出来。
耗费了不少体力，晚饭也没吃饱。
现在已是深夜。
他打算顺道碰碰运气。
看能不能遇见通宵经营的铺子。
回去麻烦风二娘的话，铁定要吃大逼兜。
沿街一路走，哪有什么店家。
偶然见两个过路的醉汉，边走边骂。
“娘的，谁特么在烟柳巷放的火，难得婆娘不在，白瞎了大把的好时光。”
“可不，老子找谁都想好了，就指着晚上寻点年轻时的激情，草他大爷。”
端木斋上前，拦住醉汉。
“大哥，那烟柳巷，晚上营业不？”
两个醉汉齐齐抬头：“营个蛋蛋，招火灾了，起码小半个月才能恢复。”
闻言，端木斋就更奇怪了。
在他端木城，发生火灾的话，官家的差爷可是满街乱窜的。
今儿怎么不见巡检司的人。
果然是有事真不上。
路过一个酒楼，抬头一望。
“好大的金字招牌，世豪酒楼，哟，原来是土皇帝开的，难怪这么大排场。”
嘀咕一句后，见大门开着，端木斋便进了屋，想看看能不能捞点吃的。

开门待客，总不能在店里打人砸自己招牌吧。
一进门，傻眼了。
别说吃的，人都看不见一个。
“有人吗？”端木斋扯着嗓子喊道。
没人回应，只有风声。
“邪了门了，这么大店，不看着，也不怕遭贼。”
正要转身离开，却听闻后面传来异响。
似乎有什么人碰翻了东西。
“你看，小贼这不就来了？”
揉了揉肚子，饿得慌，端木斋改变想法。
“算了，回去吵到二娘睡觉，铁定被修理，咱也做一回小贼吧。”
端木斋边走边念叨：“兄弟，一会你偷银子，我偷吃的，你可别拿刀砍我哈。”
走过前庭，后面便是一个天井。
右手边厨房，正前方是后院。
响声在后院，去厨房偷吃的互不干扰，合作越快，简直完美。
正喜滋滋幻想着大烧鹅呢。
后院突然嘎吱一声，门开了。
门檐下阴影中，有个黑影斜靠着门框。
“我去，兄弟，够大胆啊，光明正大的偷啊这是。”
本着多一事不如少一事的原则，端木斋本不想管。

可转头的时候，余光扫到那人，似乎有一条腿落地不踏实，是垫着的。
“不是吧，秀才？”
content_en:
On the street, Duanmuzhai was busy working until now and came out of Liu's house.
It took a lot of energy and I didn’t have enough for dinner.
It's late at night now.
He planned to try his luck along the way.
See if you can find a shop that operates all night.
If I go back to trouble Feng Erniang, I will definitely eat her big dick.
Walking along the street, there are no shops anywhere.
I happened to see two drunk men passing by, cursing them as they walked.
"Damn it, who set the fire in Yanliu Lane? It's rare that my mother-in-law is not here, so a lot of good time has been wasted."
"No, I've already thought about who to look for, so I'm just looking for some youthful passion at night to make fun of him."
Duanmuzhai stepped forward and stopped the drunkard.
"Brother, is Yanliu Lane open at night?"
The two drunk men raised their heads at the same time: "Camp up here, it's a fire. It will take at least half a month to recover."
Hearing this, Duanmuzhai was even more strange.
In Duanmu City, if a fire broke out, the official's servants would run around in the streets.
Why don't we see anyone from the Inspection Department today?
As expected, something really happened.
Passing by a restaurant, I looked up.
"What a big gold-lettered sign, Shihao Restaurant. Oh, it turns out it was opened by the Tu Emperor. No wonder it's such a grand event."
After muttering something, seeing that the door was open, Duanmuzhai entered the house to see if he could get some food.
When you open the door to entertain customers, you can't hit people in the store and smash your own sign.
As soon as I walked in, I was dumbfounded.
Not to mention food, no one can see it.
"Is there anyone there?" Duanmuzhai shouted at the top of his lungs.
No one responded, just the wind.
"It's crazy. It's such a big store. If you don't keep an eye on it, you won't be afraid of being robbed."
Just as he was about to turn around and leave, he heard a strange noise coming from behind.
It seemed like someone had knocked something over.
"Look, isn't the little thief here?"
After rubbing his stomach, feeling hungry, Duanmuzhai changed his mind.
"Forget it, if we go back and disturb the second mother to sleep, we will definitely be repaired. Let's be a little thief for once."
Duanmuzhai muttered as he walked: "Brother, you will steal money and I will steal food. Don't chop me with a knife."
After walking through the vestibule, there is a patio behind.
The kitchen is on the right, and the backyard is directly in front.
The noise is in the backyard, and they can go to the kitchen to steal food without interfering with each other. The faster they work together, it's perfect.
I am happily fantasizing about the big roast goose.
There was a sudden creak in the backyard and the door opened.
In the shadow under the door eaves, there was a dark figure leaning against the door frame.
"I'll go, brother, you're so bold, you can steal it openly and justly."
In line with the principle that more things are worse than less things, Duanmuzhai didn't want to interfere.
But when he turned his head, he glanced at the man from the corner of his eye. It seemed that one of his legs was not firmly on the ground, and it was padded.
"Isn't that right, scholar?"
